pointers.Original Text: スーパーの朝市で広告の品もゲットしたし、休日だからホスト部の個性豊かなメンバーに頭を悩ませることもないし。
pointers.New Text:
Got sale items at the market. No
Host Club today, thank goodness.
pointers.MT Text:
Got sale items at the market. No
Host Club today, thank goodness.

pointers.Original Text: 「ハルヒー。ワタシあっついお茶が飲みたいな～」
pointers.New Text:
Haruhi. I want to drink some hot
tea~
pointers.MT Text: Harue, I wanna drink some hot tea~
Ah, okay. I'll let you in now...

pointers.New Text: Hmm? Could it be a customer?

pointers.Original Text: お茶を入れる為に立ち上がったついでに、ドアへと向かう。
pointers.New Text:
I stood up to make tea and
headed for the door.
pointers.MT Text:
I stood up to make some tea and
headed for the door while I was at
it.

pointers.Original Text: 「いるんだったら早く出た方がいいよー」
pointers.New Text: Better come out if you're here--
pointers.MT Text:
If you're here, it's best to come
out sooner rather than later, ya
know?

pointers.Original Text: 「でないと学校でのあることないこと」
pointers.New Text:
Or else I'll make up something
about you at school.
pointers.MT Text:
Or else I'll make up something
about you at school.

pointers.Original Text: 「あることないことって何ですか！　脅すようなことを言わなくてもちゃんと開けます！」
pointers.New Text:
What do you mean by that! I'll
open it even if you don't have
to threaten me!
pointers.MT Text:
What do you mean by saying things
that aren't true! I'll open it just
fine without you threatening me!

pointers.Original Text: 折角の休日なのに、この人たちはまた遊びにきたのか……。
pointers.New Text:
It's their day off yet they came
to play again...
pointers.MT Text:
It's a rare day off and these guys
are here to play again...

pointers.Original Text: 悪気はないんだろうけど、価値観が違いすぎるせいか自分の暮らしに対してとても失礼な発言が多い。
pointers.New Text:
Values clash badly, rude remarks
fly.
pointers.MT Text:
Values clash badly, rude remarks
fly.

pointers.Original Text: だからあまり家にも呼びたくないんだけど……。
pointers.New Text:
So I don't really want to call
you over to my place...
pointers.MT Text:
So I don't really want to call
you over to my place...
...I'm gonna bother you for a bit.
Hey there, nice to meet you.

pointers.Original Text: そしてこのまま帰ってくれたら嬉しいんですけどね。
pointers.New Text:
I'd be happy if you went home
now.
pointers.MT Text:
And I'd be happy if you just went
home now.

pointers.Original Text: 「急に訪ねてきてしまって悪いな」
pointers.New Text:
I'm sorry to drop by so
suddenly.
pointers.MT Text: Sorry to drop by all of a sudden.

pointers.Original Text: 「謝るくらいなら事前に知らせておいて下さい」
pointers.New Text:
Please let me know beforehand
rather than apologizing later.
pointers.MT Text:
Instead of apologizing later, just
let me know beforehand.

pointers.Original Text: 「まあ、俺たちにも都合があるしな」
pointers.New Text: Well, we have our reasons too.
pointers.MT Text: Well, we've got our own reasons too.

pointers.Original Text: 「たまたまメンバーの都合があったから来たという事情を先に説明するには無理があるというものだろう」
pointers.New Text:
It's hard to explain that I came
because of a coincidence with
the members' schedules.
pointers.MT Text:
It's hard to explain that I came
because of a coincidence with
the members' schedules.

pointers.Original Text: 「それは申し訳ありませんでした」
その理屈で言うと、自分の都合はばっさりと切り捨てられてますよね。
pointers.New Text:
If I follow that logic, you're
just throwing my feelings aside.
pointers.MT Text:
If I follow that logic, you're
just throwing my feelings aside.

pointers.Original Text: 「ハルヒはおとーさんに会えない間寂しかったかにゃ？」
pointers.New Text:
Did my princess feel lonely
without your dad?
pointers.MT Text:
Was Haruhi lonely without seeing
dad?

pointers.Original Text: 「いえ、むしろ会いたくなかったです」
pointers.New Text: No, I didn't want to see you.
pointers.MT Text: No, I didn't want to see you.

pointers.Original Text: 「おかーさん！　ハルヒが、ハルヒが～」
「で、自分の家にみなさんは何をしにきたんですか？　事前に連絡があれば何か用意も出来たんですけど……」
pointers.New Text:
Why did you come to my house? I
could've prepared if you told
me.
pointers.MT Text:
Why did you come to my house? I
could've prepared if you told
me.

pointers.Original Text: 「あら？　鏡夜くんじゃない。お久しぶりー」
pointers.New Text:
Oh? Isn't that Kyoya-kun. Long
time no see!
pointers.MT Text:
Oh? Isn't that Kyoya-kun. Long
time no see!

pointers.Original Text: 「お久しぶりです。蘭花さんは変わらずお美しいですね」
pointers.New Text:
It's been a while. You're still
beautiful as ever.
pointers.MT Text:
It's been a while. You're still as
beautiful as ever, Lan Hua.

pointers.Original Text: 「やだーありがとう。そこにいるのは埴之塚くんに銛之塚くんよね？」
pointers.New Text:
Eww, thanks. The ones there are
Kurakano-kun and Kamikamo-kun,
right?
pointers.MT Text:
Eww, thanks. The ones there are
Kurakano-kun and Kamikamo-kun,
right?

pointers.Original Text: 「うふふ。今日はハルヒに用事かしら？」
pointers.New Text:
Hmm? Do you have something for
Haruhi today?
pointers.MT Text:
Hmm? Do you have something for
Haruhi today?

pointers.Original Text: 「ええ、まあ。蘭花さんはお仕事お休みですか？」
pointers.New Text:
Yeah, well. Are you off work
today, Ran-kun?
pointers.MT Text:
Oh, really? Are you off work today,
Ranha?

pointers.Original Text: 「たまにはハルヒと親子の時間でも作ろうと思ってね」
pointers.New Text:
I thought I'd make some
father-daughter time with my
princess.
pointers.MT Text:
I thought I'd make some
father-daughter time with my
princess.

pointers.Original Text: 「そうでしたか。親子水入らずの時間を割いてしまい申し訳ありません」
pointers.New Text:
I see. I apologize for taking
time away from our alone time.
pointers.MT Text:
Oh, I see. Sorry for interrupting
your quality family time.

pointers.Original Text: 「やだ、そんな気にしなくて良いのよ～。騒がしいのは嫌いじゃないもの」
pointers.New Text:
Eww, don't worry about it~ I
don't mind noisy people.
pointers.MT Text:
Eww, don't worry about it~ I
don't mind noisy people.

pointers.Original Text: 「あの、その、あの。お、俺のことは……」
（ハルヒのパパさんの殿に対する印象って激悪だよね）
pointers.New Text:
(Haruhi's dad really hates him,
doesn't he?)
pointers.MT Text:
(Haruhi's dad has a really bad
impression of Lord Nishizumi.)

pointers.Original Text: （初対面で娘を押し倒してる男を見ればそりゃあ印象最悪じゃない？）
pointers.New Text:
Worst first meet: guy pins
"daughter" Tamaki thinks it's
awful seeing that. Wouldn't you?
pointers.MT Text:
Worst first meet: guy pins
"daughter" Tamaki thinks it's
awful seeing that. Wouldn't you?

pointers.Original Text: （つくづく殿ってむくわれないよね～行動が空回りしすぎてある意味それも一種の才能っていうかさ）
pointers.New Text:
(Milord never gets rewarded for
his efforts... backfiring this
much is almost a talent.)
pointers.MT Text:
He can't catch a break.
It's like he has a talent
for messing things up.

pointers.Original Text: 「あのー和んでいるところ申し訳ないんですけど……」
pointers.New Text:
Um, sorry to bother you while
you're relaxing...
pointers.MT Text:
Um, I'm sorry to bother you while
you're relaxing...

pointers.Original Text: 「ああ、手土産ならちゃんと持参してきているぞ」
pointers.New Text:
Of course, I brought proper
gifts.
pointers.MT Text: Oh yeah, I brought a proper gift.

pointers.Original Text: 「いえ、そうゆうことではなくてですね……」
pointers.MT Text: Oh, it's not quite like that...

pointers.Original Text: 「庶民料理のすき焼きというものを食したくなってな。もちろん材料費はこちらもちだ」
pointers.New Text:
I feel like having sukiyaki, a
dish for commoners. Of course,
I'll cover all the ingredients.
pointers.MT Text:
I feel like shabu-shabu,
home style. Of course,
I'll pay for everything.

pointers.Original Text: 「これが材料費だ。なるべく高級な素材を見繕うように」
pointers.New Text:
These are the material costs.
Try to pick high-quality
materials.
pointers.MT Text:
This is for materials. Try to pick
out the best quality stuff you can.

pointers.Original Text: ぽんっと手の上に分厚い財布がのせられる。
pointers.New Text:
A thick wallet is placed on my
hand with a thud.
pointers.MT Text:
A thick wallet is slapped down on my
hand.

pointers.Original Text: あの、自分の言い分は無視ですよね？　明らかに。
pointers.New Text:
You're ignoring my side of the
story, right? Obviously.
pointers.MT Text:
Hey, you're ignoring what I'm
saying, right? Obviously.

pointers.Original Text: 「この辺りの事情に我々は明るくないからな」
pointers.New Text:
We're not familiar with this
area.
pointers.MT Text:
We're not familiar with the lay of
the land around here.

pointers.Original Text: 「はあ、仕方ないですね。ちょっと行ってきますから大人しく待ってて下さいよ」
pointers.New Text:
Fine, I'll be back soon. Stay
put and wait for me.
pointers.MT Text:
Fine, I guess there's nothing else
to do. I'll be back in a bit, so
stay put and wait for me.

pointers.Original Text: わざわざ高級という指定をつけて、渡されたお財布もこの厚さ。この辺りのスーパーに並ぶ食材では到底期待にそえないだろう。
pointers.New Text:
He asked for high-end -- look
how thick this wallet is. No
local supermarket meets that.
pointers.MT Text:
You asked for high-end,
but this wallet won't buy
that at local stores.

pointers.Original Text: となると商店街の方に行くことになるんだけど……メンバーの肥えた舌を満足させる食材を自分もちょっとはあやかれるわけで。
pointers.New Text:
Guess we're headed to the
shopping district... I might get
to enjoy the fancy food myself.
pointers.MT Text:
Then we'll hit the shops
and find ingredients to
satisfy everyone.

pointers.Original Text: （なんか食べ物に釣られているみたいで嫌だなあ……）
pointers.New Text:
Food lure feels bad... But rare
chance. Guess I'll take the
offer, huh?
pointers.MT Text:
Food lure feels bad... But rare
chance. Guess I'll take the
offer, huh?

pointers.Original Text: まあ、こんな機会なんて滅多にないし素直にあやかっておこうかな。
「ん～お父さんもハルヒについていこっかな」
pointers.New Text:
Hmm~ Should I go with Haruhi
too?
pointers.MT Text:
Hmm~ Should I go with Haruhi
too?

pointers.Original Text: 「娘とのスキンシップも大事だもの～」
pointers.New Text:
It's important to bond with my
daughter too~
pointers.MT Text:
It's important to have skinship with
your daughter too~

pointers.Original Text: 「ハルヒとおとうさんのお供をさせて下さい！！」
pointers.New Text:
Let me accompany my princess and
father!!
pointers.MT Text: Let me accompany Haruhi and dad!!

pointers.Original Text: 「……空気が読めない子ね、あんたは」
「ぬうう。俺は是非おとうさんに認めてもらおうと！」
pointers.New Text:
Noooo. I'll definitely get my
dad to acknowledge me!
pointers.MT Text:
Ugh, I really want my dad to
acknowledge me!

pointers.Original Text: 「えっと、その……俺のおとうさんとしての立場を！」
pointers.New Text:
Uh, well... As my dad's
position!

pointers.Original Text: 「アホは放っておいて２人で行きましょうか」
pointers.New Text:
Let's go together and leave the
idiot behind.

pointers.Original Text: 「ま、待って下さい！　おとうさん！」
「あんたにおとうさんって連呼される覚えはないんだけどね～」
pointers.New Text:
I don't have any memory of you
calling me 'daddy,' though~
pointers.MT Text:
I don't have a memory of you calling
me daddy though~

pointers.Original Text: 「お父さん！　このままだと環先輩にキノコが生えてまた面倒なことになるから……」
pointers.New Text:
Dad! If we don't do something,
Tama-chan will grow mushrooms
again and cause more trouble...
pointers.MT Text:
Dad! Keep this up and
Senpai will grow mushrooms
again. What a hassle.

pointers.Original Text: 「もう、しょーがないわねえ。いいわよ、ついてきても」
pointers.New Text:
Fine, I guess there's no help
for it. Come on then.
pointers.MT Text:
Oh, fine. Whatever. You can follow
me if you want.

......what are you gonna do about
it?

pointers.Original Text: 「殿とハルヒのパパさん一緒に出かけちゃったじゃん」
pointers.New Text:
You went out together with my
dad and Tamaki-sama.
pointers.MT Text:
You went out together with my
dad and Tamaki-sama.

pointers.Original Text: 「当初の予定とは違うが、軌道修正可能だろう」
pointers.New Text:
We can adjust course even if
it's not what we planned.
pointers.MT Text:
We'll have to change course from our
original plan, but it's doable.

pointers.Original Text: 「ふーん。まあ、これから先は鏡夜先輩に任せて」
pointers.New Text:
Hmm. Well, I'll leave it to you
from now on, Kyoya-senpai.
pointers.MT Text:
Hmm. Well, I'll leave it to you from
now on, Kyouya-senpai.

pointers.Original Text: 「僕たちは面白おかしく騒いでいればいいよねー」
pointers.New Text:
We just gotta make a fun ruckus,
right~?
pointers._flag: Sergio blank; filled from Argos baseline for playable build

pointers.Original Text: 「なるべく高級な食材をということなので、スーパーではなく商店街の方に行ってみたいと思います」
ここからだと２駅先の商店街まで行くことになるから、短く見積もっても４０分はかかる。
pointers.New Text:
It will take at least 40 minutes
to get to the shopping street
two stations away from here.
pointers.MT Text:
From here, it'll take at least 40
minutes to get to the shopping
street two stations away.

pointers.Original Text: ホスト部メンバーが満足するほどの食材が揃うかはわからないけど、確実に近所で高級食材を見つけるのは困難を極めるからね。
pointers.New Text:
Host Club may not be pleased,
but finding top-notch stuff's
tough.
pointers.MT Text:
Host Club may not be pleased,
but finding top-notch stuff's
tough.

pointers.Original Text: 確か、あの商店街の先には大型のスーパーやデパートもあったはずだから、場合によってはそこまで歩けばいいわけだし。
pointers.New Text:
Past the shops is a big
supermarket. We could walk there
if needed.
pointers.MT Text:
Past the shops is a big
supermarket. We could walk there
if needed.

pointers.Original Text: 「商店街か！　色々なお店があって賑々しくしているのだろうなあ！」
pointers.New Text:
The shopping district! It must
be bustling with all sorts of
shops!
pointers.MT Text:
The shopping district! It must
be bustling with all sorts of
shops!

pointers.Original Text: 「まあ、今日は休みなのでいつもより混んでいると思いますよ」
pointers.New Text:
Well, since today's a holiday, I
think it'll be busier than
usual.
pointers.MT Text:
Well, it's a holiday today, so I
think it'll be more crowded than
usual.

pointers.Original Text: 「おお、そうか！　前に皆の衆で行ったスーパーも異国のカーニバルのように賑わっていたがそれを上回る賑やかさか？」
pointers.New Text:
Oh, is that so! More lively than
the supermarket we went to? Even
more like a carnival?
pointers.MT Text:
Oh, is that so! More lively than
the supermarket we went to? Even
more like a carnival?

pointers.Original Text: 「異国のカーニバルは言いすぎですけど、それより騒がしいですね、あそこは」
pointers.New Text:
That's an exaggeration, but it
sure is noisy over there.
pointers.MT Text:
It's not quite a carnival in a
foreign land, but it's definitely
noisier over there.

pointers.Original Text: 「……嬉しさを言葉に出すなんてこの子、ハルヒより年上よね？」
pointers.New Text:
...To put your happiness into
words, you must be older than
Haruhi?
pointers.MT Text:
...To put your happiness into
words, you must be older than
Haruhi?

pointers.New Text: I am your senior after all.

pointers.Original Text: 「こんなのが先輩って世も末よねえ」
pointers.New Text:
This is what you call an
upperclassman? The world's
coming to an end.
pointers.MT Text:
Talk about setting a new low for
senpais.

pointers.Original Text: 「でも……ちょっとお父さんに似てますよ、環先輩」
pointers.New Text:
But... you kind of remind me of
my dad, Tamaki-senpai.
pointers.MT Text:
But... you kind of remind me of your
dad, Kan senpai.

pointers.Original Text: 「！！？　やめてよね～ワタシはもっとスマートよ？　それにこんな子供っぽいんだかアホなんだかわからないキャラじゃないわよ」
pointers.New Text:
!!? Cut it out~ I'm way more
sophisticated! I'm not some
childish, dumb character, okay?
pointers.MT Text:
!!? Come on, don't do that~ I'm way
smarter than this? And I'm not some
dumb kid character!

pointers.Original Text: 「おとうさんと一緒か！　それは光栄だな！」
pointers.New Text:
Are you with my dad too?! That's
an honor!
pointers.MT Text:
Are you with your dad! That's an
honor!

pointers.Original Text: 「ワタシはぜったいに認めませんからね！　あんたは敵、敵！」
pointers.New Text:
I won't ever acknowledge you!
You're my enemy, enemy!
pointers.MT Text:
I won't ever admit it! You're the
enemy, the enemy!

pointers.Original Text: うーん、行動も言動も結構似てるんだけどなあ。
pointers.New Text:
Hmm, our actions and words are
pretty similar.
pointers.MT Text:
Hmm, their actions and words are
pretty similar though.

pointers.Original Text: もしかしてあれかな、同属嫌悪。
（あれはあれで案外仲良しなのかもね）
pointers.New Text:
Guess they're close after all.
Too troublesome to argue. Let's
leave it.
pointers.MT Text:
Guess they're close after all.
Too troublesome to argue. Let's
leave it.

pointers.Original Text: いろいろと突っ込むのも面倒なので、そうゆうことにしておこう、うん。
「まずどこから見て行きましょうか？」
「ハルヒ、中心部にいけば専門店があるわよ」
pointers.New Text:
Haruhi, there are specialty
stores in the center.
pointers.MT Text:
Haruhi, there's a specialty store in
the downtown area.

pointers.Original Text: 「ハルヒ、ハルヒ！　人がいっぱいいてなんだか楽しそうだなぁ！」
pointers.New Text:
Haruhi, Haruhi! There are so
many people and it looks like a
lot of fun!
pointers.MT Text:
Haruhi, Haruhi! There are so many
people here and it looks like
everyone's having a great time!

pointers.Original Text: 「あーそうですね。じゃあ中心部に行って店を回ってみましょう」
pointers.New Text:
Okay, let's go to the center and
check out some stores.
pointers.MT Text:
Oh yeah, right. Let's go to the
center and check out some stores.

pointers.Original Text: （タマちゃん楽しそうだねえ）
（僕らも含め、こうゆうところで買い物することってないじゃん）
pointers.New Text:
(We never do shopping here, even
including ourselves.)
pointers.MT Text:
(We don't usually do shopping in
places like this, you know.)

pointers.Original Text: （そうそう。特に殿は楽しいものに目がないからね～）
pointers.New Text:
(Sure thing. Our prince
especially loves fun things~)
pointers.MT Text:
(Of course. Our lord has a thing for
fun stuff~)

pointers.Original Text: （だからハルヒのパパさんに馬鹿とか言われちゃうんだよね）
pointers.New Text:
(That's why Haruhi's dad calls
me an idiot.)
pointers.MT Text:
(That's why Haruhi's dad calls
me an idiot.)

pointers.Original Text: （たいへんたいへーん！　早く着いていかないと！）
pointers.New Text: (Oh no oh no! We have to hurry!)
pointers.MT Text:
(Oh no oh no! We have to get there
quick!)

pointers.Original Text: （……あまり騒ぐと気付かれるぞ。まあ、既に気付かれている可能性はあるようだが）
pointers.New Text:
(...Too much noise and they'll
notice us. Though we might
already be noticed.)
pointers.MT Text:
Don't make noise or
we'll get caught. They
may have noticed us.

pointers.Original Text: 「んーん。なんでもない。さ、早く行きましょ」
pointers.New Text:
Mm-mm. Nothing's wrong. C'mon,
let's go.

pointers.Original Text: 「さあ寄ってらっしゃい、見てらっしゃい。今から２０分のタイムセールの開始だよ！」
pointers.New Text:
C'mon over and take a look! The
time-limited sale starts in
twenty minutes!
pointers.MT Text:
C'mon folks, come and take a look!
The time sale starts in 20 minutes!

pointers.Original Text: 「サーロインステーキ定価１０００円のところを今ならなんと８００円！」
pointers.New Text:
Sirloin steak! Regular price
1000 yen, now just 800 yen!
pointers.MT Text:
Ribeye steak normally 1000 yen but
now just 800 yen!

pointers.Original Text: 「破産覚悟の大出血サービスだ！！　さあ、早い者勝ちだよ！」
pointers.New Text:
Bankruptcy be damned, this is a
huge loss service!! First come,
first served!
pointers.MT Text:
Prepare for a massive bloodbath of
service!! It's first come, first
served!

pointers.Original Text: 「なななななんと、破産覚悟な上に大出血サービスをするなどなんたる博愛精神！！」
pointers.New Text:
What kind of philanthropy is
this? Bankrupting yourself and
offering such a huge discount!!
pointers.MT Text:
What? Bankrupt, yet such
a huge discount? What
saintly generosity!

pointers.Original Text: 「これは善良な市民としてあの店のために並ばねば！！」
pointers.New Text:
I must wait in line for that
shop as a good citizen!!
pointers.MT Text:
This is what a good citizen does! I
gotta wait in line for that store!!

pointers.Original Text: ちょっと目を離した隙に、環先輩がふらふらとタイムサービスを始めた店に引き寄せられていく。
pointers.New Text:
Just when I look away, Senpai
starts dragging me to a store
offering freebies.
pointers.MT Text:
Just when I look away, Senpai
starts dragging me to a store
offering freebies.

pointers.Original Text: うかつだった……。環先輩はお涙ちょうだいものとかに弱いんだった。
pointers.New Text:
I was careless... Senpai can't
resist sob stories.
pointers.MT Text:
I was careless... Senpai is weak to
stuff that makes you go "aww."

pointers.Original Text: 「行かなくていいです。あまりうろちょろしないで下さいよ？　自分もこの辺りに詳しくないんですから」
pointers.New Text:
You don't have to go. Don't
wander too much, okay? I'm not
familiar here either.
pointers.MT Text:
You don't have to go. Don't
wander too much, okay? I'm not
familiar here either.

pointers.Original Text: 「しかし破産覚悟と腹をくくっているのをスルーするのはいかがなものかにゃ？」
pointers.New Text:
Isn't it a bit reckless to
ignore the fact that you're
prepared for bankruptcy?
pointers.MT Text:
But isn't it a bit much to just
brush off someone who's already
prepared for bankruptcy?

pointers.Original Text: 「実際には破産しませんし、それが狙いなんですよ。はいはい、行きますよ」
pointers.New Text:
We won't actually go bankrupt.
That's the point. All right,
let's do it.
pointers.MT Text:
I'm not actually going to declare
bankruptcy; that's the whole point.
Okay, okay, I'll do it.

pointers.Original Text: 「今日は祝日サービスデイ！　ポイントが通常の３倍つくよー！　３００円のお買い物につき１ポイントが今日は３ポイント！」
pointers.New Text:
Today's a holiday service day!
Triple points! Normally 1 point
per 300 yen, but today it's 3!
pointers.MT Text:
Holiday service day!
Triple points: three points
per 300 yen!

pointers.Original Text: 「この機会にポイントカードをつくる予定のお客様、どうぞよって見て下さい！」
pointers.New Text:
Customers planning to get point
cards, please take a look!
pointers.MT Text:
Customers who plan to make a points
card this chance, please take a
look!

pointers.Original Text: 「なななななんと、通常では３００円１ポイントを今日は３倍にしてくれるのか！」
pointers.New Text:
"Whaaat, you're giving three
times the usual points today?"!
pointers.MT Text:
Wh-what? You're saying that instead
of 300 yen per point, it's triple
today!

pointers.Original Text: 「ということは、９００円のお買い物をしたのと同じポイントがつくと言うのだな！　なんと、お買い得な日なのだ！！」
pointers.New Text:
That means I get the same points
as if I spent 900 yen! What a
great deal!!
pointers.MT Text:
That means I get the same points
as if I spent 900 yen! What a
great deal!!

pointers.Original Text: 「あーはいはい、行きますよー」
pointers.MT Text: Okay, okay, I'm on my way.

pointers.New Text:
Yeah, the shop... is getting
farther away~
pointers.MT Text:
Aah, the store's... getting farther
away~

pointers.Original Text: 「さあさあ、店じまいセールだ！　定価の半額なんてざらだよ、ざら！」
pointers.New Text:
C'mon, c'mon! It's our closing
sale! Half price is the norm
here!
pointers.MT Text:
C'mon, c'mon! It's our store closing
sale! Prices are half off all the
time, I swear!

pointers.Original Text: 「なななななんと、定価の半額！！　儲けなどないではないか！！　しかも店じまいとならばここはこの須王環、一肌脱がねば！」
pointers.New Text:
Half price?! No profit! Must
help Kurakano!
pointers.MT Text:
Half price?! No profit! Must
help Kurakano!

pointers.Original Text: あーもう。環先輩を連れてきたのは失敗だったかなあ。
pointers.New Text:
Aw, maybe bringing Tama-chan was
a mistake.
pointers.MT Text:
Aw, maybe bringing Tama-chan was
a mistake.
pointers._flag: Sergio blank; filled from Argos baseline for playable build

pointers.Original Text: 「もしかして……俺は邪魔かにゃ？」

pointers.New Text: Yeah, you're kind of in the way.
pointers.MT Text: Yeah, you're kind of a nuisance.
N-no. I'll go easy on you...

pointers.Original Text: 「そうしてくれると助かります」
pointers.New Text: That would be a great help.
pointers.MT Text:
It'd be a big help if you could do
that.

Let's be honest, you're a pain in
the ass.

pointers.Original Text: 「目的地以外のところで立ち止まってばっかりいられると迷惑よね～」
pointers.New Text:
Standing still everywhere else
is annoying~
pointers.MT Text:
It's such a hassle when you keep
stopping everywhere except the
destination.

pointers.Original Text: 「わああああん！　俺は最低の人間です～」
pointers.New Text:
Waaaaaaaaah! I'm the worst
person ever--!
pointers.MT Text:
AAAAAAAAHH! I'm such a fucking
loser!

pointers.Original Text: #Scale[0.7]「ごめんなさいぃぃーーーー」
……あの時、違った返事をしていれば、別の結末もあったのかな？
pointers.New Text:
...If I had answered differently
back then, would things have
turned out differently?
pointers.MT Text:
...If I had answered differently
back then, would things have
turned out differently?

pointers.Original Text: もし、あの時に戻れたら、今度は別の答え方を……
pointers.New Text:
If I could go back to that
moment, I'd answer differently
this time...
pointers.MT Text:
If I could go back to that
moment, I'd answer differently
this time...

pointers.Original Text: 「んーそんなに邪魔ではないですよ」
pointers.New Text:
Hmm, it's not that much of an
obstruction.
pointers.MT Text: Uh, it's not that much of a bother.

pointers.Original Text: ちょっとウザく思う時はありますけど。
pointers.MT Text: Sometimes I find him a bit annoying.

pointers.Original Text: 「そ、そうか！　うむ、ほっとしたぞ」
pointers.New Text: Is that so! Well, I'm relieved.
pointers.MT Text: S-So that's it! Phew, I'm relieved.

pointers.Original Text: 「慣れてますから。別に邪魔とか思いませんよ」
pointers.New Text:
I'm used to it. I don't think of
it as getting in the way.
pointers.MT Text:
I'm used to it, so I don't mind if
it feels like an intrusion.

pointers.Original Text: 「そうか！　ハルヒに嫌われたらどうしようかと思ったぞ。良かった良かった」
pointers.New Text:
Really? I was worried you'd hate
me! Phew, that's a relief!
pointers.MT Text:
Oh! I was worried what would happen
if Haruhi hated me. Phew, that's a
relief.

pointers.Original Text: 「？　ああ、あれはカプセル自販機ですね」
pointers.New Text:
Hmm? Oh, that's a capsule
vending machine.
pointers.MT Text:
Huh? Oh, that's a capsule vending
machine.

pointers.Original Text: 「ガチャとかポンとか言われているんですけど、お金を投入して取っ手を回すと中からカプセルが出てくるんです」
pointers.New Text:
That's what they call gacha or
pona. You put in money, turn the
crank, and a capsule comes out.
pointers.MT Text:
They call it a gacha or pachinko
machine, but you put in money, pull
the lever, and out pops a capsule.

pointers.Original Text: 「おおおお！　それは面白そうだ！！」
「よし！　やってみようではないか！　……ハルヒ」
pointers.New Text:
All right! Let's give it a try!
...Haruhi!
pointers.MT Text:
Alright! Let's give it a shot!
...Haruhi

pointers.Original Text: 「う、うむ。小銭を貸してくれないかにゃーなんて」
pointers.New Text:
「U-Um. Not that I wanted you to
lend me money nya~」
pointers.MT Text:
「U-Um. Not that I wanted you to
lend me money nya~」

pointers.Original Text: いつも思うんですが、なんでたまに猫口調なんですか環先輩……。
pointers.New Text:
I always wonder why you
sometimes talk like a cat,
Senpai...
pointers.MT Text:
I always wonder why you
sometimes talk like a cat,
Senpai...

pointers.Original Text: 「仕方ないですね。はい、５００円。ちゃんと返して下さいよ」
pointers.New Text:
Can't be helped. Here's 500 yen.
Make sure to give it back.
pointers.MT Text:
Well, I guess there's nothing to do
about it. Here you go, 500 yen. Make
sure to give it back to me.

pointers.Original Text: 「おおおお！　ありがとう、ハルヒ！！」

pointers.New Text:
Close, close. Our faces are so
close.
pointers.MT Text:
I'm close, close. Our faces are so
close.

pointers.Original Text: 「お、俺としたことがついはしゃいでしまったな」
pointers.MT Text:
Man, I can't believe I got so worked
up.

pointers.Original Text: ……いつもはしゃいでますよね。
「１回１００円か。なんと５回も出来るのか！これは楽しみだなあ」
pointers.New Text:
100 yen per game? I can play
five times! This is fun!
pointers.MT Text:
It's 100 yen per use? I can do it
five times! This is gonna be fun.

pointers.Original Text: 「いや、いいんだ。俺がハルヒを困らせるようなことを言ったのが悪いんだよな」
pointers.New Text:
No, it's fine. I'm the one who
said something to make Haruhi
uncomfortable.
pointers.MT Text:
No, it's fine. I'm the one who
said something to make Haruhi
uncomfortable.

pointers.Original Text: 「庶民が楽しむ行事というものを俺も体感してみたかったが、それは次の機会に……」
pointers.New Text:
Wanted to try commoner fun, next
time...
pointers.MT Text:
Wanted to try commoner fun, next
time...

pointers.Original Text: 「次の機会があるよな、ハルヒ？」
pointers.New Text:
Will there be another chance,
Haruhi?
pointers.MT Text:
Next time we'll have a chance,
Haruhi?

pointers.Original Text: 「～～～はい、５００円です。これで遊んでて下さい！」
pointers.New Text:
Here you go, 500 yen! Have fun
with this!
pointers.MT Text:
Here you go, 500 yen! Have fun
with this!

pointers.Original Text: 「いろいろ種類があるが、さてさて、どのガチャで遊ぼうかな～♪」
pointers.New Text:
Wow, there are so many kinds!
Hm, which one should I play
with~?
pointers.MT Text:
Wow, there are so many kinds!
Hm, which one should I play
with~?

pointers.Original Text: 「環先輩。自分たちは雑貨店に用事があるので、終わったら雑貨店に来て下さい」
pointers.New Text:
Tamaki-senpai, we need you at
sundries shop.
pointers.MT Text:
Tamaki-senpai, we need you at
sundries shop.

pointers.Original Text: どうせ暫くはここで足止めされるんだし、その
pointers.New Text:
Since we'll be stuck here for a
while anyway, I might as well
take care of my business.
pointers.MT Text:
Since we're gonna be stuck here for
a while anyway, might as well get
comfortable with it.

pointers.Original Text: 間に自分の用を済ませてしまおう。
pointers.MT Text:
Let me take care of my business
while I'm at it.

pointers.Original Text: 「くれぐれも迷子にならないで下さいね。探すの大変なんですから」
pointers.New Text:
Please don't get lost. It's such
a hassle to look for you.
pointers.MT Text:
Please don't get lost. It's a real
pain to look for you.

pointers.Original Text: 「どっちが年上かわかんないわよね～」
「まあ、これが環先輩ですから。じゃあ行ってきます」
pointers.New Text:
Well, that's just how Tama-chan
is. I'll be going now.
pointers.MT Text:
Well, that's just how Tama-chan
is. I'll be going now.

pointers.Original Text: 「！？　ど、どうしたんですか環先輩」
必死の形相でこっちに駆けてくる環先輩と、何故か隣には５、６歳の女の子を連れている。
pointers.New Text:
Tamaki-senpai runs, frantic,
with a young girl by his side.
Why?
pointers.MT Text:
Tamaki-senpai runs, frantic,
with a young girl by his side.
Why?

pointers.Original Text: 「それだけじゃ全然わかりません」
pointers.MT Text:
I still have no clue what you're
talking about.

pointers.Original Text: 「実はだな。買い物をしている間、この子も俺と同じ様に自販機の前で待つよう母親に言われたらしくてな」
pointers.New Text:
Her mom said to wait there too.
Like me. While shopping.
pointers.MT Text:
Her mom said to wait there too.
Like me. While shopping.

pointers.Original Text: 「それからかれこれ３０分は経っているが母親がいっこうに姿を現さないというのだ！」
pointers.New Text:
It's been about thirty minutes,
but my mother still hasn't shown
up!
pointers.MT Text:
It's been about 30 minutes already
and my mom still hasn't shown up!

pointers.Original Text: 「だろう！　しかもだ、この子のお母上は妊娠中であまり具合が良くない。何処ぞで倒れていたら一大事だろう？」
pointers.New Text:
Right?! Her mother's pregnant
and unwell too. If she collapsed
somewhere, that'd be a disaster!
pointers.MT Text:
Right! Worse, her mother
is pregnant and unwell.
If she collapsed, trouble!

pointers.Original Text: 「確かにそれは一大事ですね」
pointers.MT Text: That is indeed a big deal.

pointers.Original Text: 「鏡夜！　お前いつからそこに！？」
pointers.New Text: Kyoya! When did you get there!?
pointers.MT Text: Kaguya! When did you get there!?

pointers.Original Text: 「時間にすれば数分前といったところだな」
pointers.New Text: It was just a few minutes ago.
pointers.MT Text:
It was just a few minutes ago if you
go by time.

pointers.Original Text: 「自分たちの後をつけてきたんですか？」
家で待ちきれなかった、とか子供っぽい理由ではないよね、流石に。
pointers.New Text:
It's not like I couldn't wait at
home or some childish excuse,
right? Of course.
pointers.MT Text:
It's not like I couldn't wait at
home or some childish excuse,
right? Of course.

pointers.Original Text: 「実はさーハルヒのパパさんの殿に対する印象をちょっとでも良くしようと思ってさ」
pointers.New Text:
I was thinking of improving your
dad's impression of me just a
little.
pointers.MT Text:
Actually, I was thinking of trying
to improve Haruhi's dad's impression
of you a little.

pointers.Original Text: 「そうそう。それでわざわざハルヒだけ買い物に行かせようとしたら肝心の２人も着いて行っちゃって」
pointers.New Text:
That's right. Tried sending
Haruhi alone, But Tamaki and
Kyoya tagged along.
pointers.MT Text:
That's right. Tried sending
Haruhi alone, But Tamaki and
Kyoya tagged along.

pointers.Original Text: 「だから仕方なく僕らも行くことになったんだよね～」
pointers.New Text: So we had to go along too~
pointers.MT Text: So we had to go too~

pointers.Original Text: 「ハルちゃん、タマちゃん、黙っててごめんね」
pointers.New Text:
Haru-chan, Tama-chan, sorry for
keeping quiet.
pointers.MT Text:
Haru-chan, Tama-chan, sorry for
keeping quiet.

pointers.Original Text: 「……ようするに、予期しない出来事だったから後をつけてきたと？」
pointers.New Text:
So you're saying you followed us
because of an unexpected event?
pointers.MT Text:
...So you're saying you followed me
because of some unexpected event?

pointers.New Text: Ha... Well, I guess it's fine.
pointers.MT Text: Ah... well, I guess it's fine.

pointers.Original Text: 「うむ、人生とは常に予測通りには動かぬものなのだよ！」
pointers.New Text:
Indeed, life never goes exactly
as planned!
pointers.MT Text:
Yeah, life never goes according to
plan!

pointers.Original Text: 「今はそのことよりも、その子供の母親探しをするんじゃないのか？」
pointers.New Text:
Aren't you supposed to be
looking for that kid's mother
right now?
pointers.MT Text:
Aren't you supposed to be looking
for that kid's mom right now
instead?

pointers.Original Text: 「おお、そうだったな。母親の居所がわからないならば父親に連絡をすべきだろうと思ったのだが、父親の連絡先を知らないのだそうだ」
pointers.New Text:
Oh, right. I thought we should
contact her father, but it turns out
she doesn't have his info either.
pointers.MT Text:
If you don't know where
your mother is, call your
father... but you can't.

pointers.Original Text: 「謝らなくても良いのだよ！　なので皆の衆にここで提案なのだが、俺が１日代理お父さんをしようと思う！」
pointers.New Text:
Don't apologize! So I have a
proposal for everyone here. I'll
be your stand-in dad for a day!
pointers.MT Text:
Don't apologize! So I have a
proposal for everyone here. I'll
be your stand-in dad for a day!

pointers.Original Text: 「は、ハルヒ！　俺がおとーさんでは駄目だろうか？」
pointers.New Text: Ha-Haruhi! Can't I be your dad?
pointers.MT Text: Ha-Haruhi! Can't I be your dad?

pointers.Original Text: 「あまり連発するのはよくないと思いますよ」
pointers.New Text:
I don't think it's good to do
that too much.
pointers.MT Text:
I don't think you should do that too
much.

pointers.Original Text: 「う、うむ……だけどこのまま放ってはおけまい」
pointers.New Text:
Y-Yes... But I can't just leave
it like this.
pointers.MT Text:
Y-Yes... But I can't just leave
it like this.

pointers.Original Text: 「よくないと思います。本当の父親がいるんですし、父親じゃなくても良いんじゃないですか？」
pointers.New Text:
I don't think that's good. You
have a real father, so maybe you
don't need another one?
pointers.MT Text:
I don't think that's a good idea. He
has a real dad after all, so maybe
he doesn't need another one?

pointers.Original Text: 「……しかし、あえて俺は復活する！　白い目で見られようと構うものか！！」
pointers.New Text:
...But I shall rise again! Who
cares if they stare at me with
those white eyes!!
pointers.MT Text:
...But I shall rise again! Who
cares if they stare at me with
those white eyes!!

pointers.Original Text: 「まあ、いいんじゃないですか。環先輩だし」
pointers.New Text:
Well, it's fine, right? He's our
king.
pointers.MT Text:
Well, I guess it's okay since it's
Senpai.

pointers.Original Text: 「そうか、そうか。ならお父さんと名乗っても大丈夫だな」
pointers.New Text:
Is that so? Then it's fine for
me to call myself your father.
pointers.MT Text:
Oh yeah, oh yeah. Then it's okay for
me to call myself dad, huh?

pointers.Original Text: 「環先輩は仮でもこの子のお父さんになりたいんですよね？」
pointers.New Text:
Are you really that desperate to
be this girl's dad, even if it's
just pretend?
pointers.MT Text:
Isn't it that you want to be this
kid's dad even if it's just for a
while, Senpai?

pointers.Original Text: 「うむ。この子の不安を少しでも拭えたらと思ってな」
pointers.New Text:
Hmm. I thought I'd ease her
worries a bit.
pointers.MT Text:
Hmm. I thought I'd ease her
worries a bit.

pointers.Original Text: 「なら……お父さんでも良いと思います、自分は」
pointers.New Text:
I think... 'Father' would be
fine for me.
pointers.MT Text:
then... I think it's fine if it's
dad, myself

pointers.Original Text: 「入り口付近に人が集まっていたからな。何を話しているのか聞いたらちょうどその子の母親のことを話題にしていたようだ」
pointers.New Text:
People gathered near the door.
They talked about her mom.
pointers.MT Text:
People gathered near the door.
They talked about her mom.

pointers.Original Text: 「なぬ！　それは願ってもない情報だ！」
pointers.New Text:
What! That's information I've
been wishing for!
pointers.MT Text:
What! That's information I've
been wishing for!

pointers.Original Text: 「お母さんは近くにいるんですか？」
「向かいのデパートで買い物をしていた主婦が陣痛を起こし病院に運ばれた。場所はここから１駅先の病院だ」
pointers.New Text:
Woman shopping near dept store.
Went into labor, rushed to hosp.
One station away from here.
pointers.MT Text:
Woman shopping near dept store.
Went into labor, rushed to hosp.
One station away from here.

pointers.Original Text: 鏡夜先輩が１枚の紙切れを環先輩に渡す。
pointers.New Text:
Kyoya-senpai hands a piece of
paper to Tamaki-senpai.
pointers.MT Text:
Kyoya-senpai hands a piece of
paper to Tamaki-senpai.

pointers.Original Text: 「そこに病院までの行き方が書いてある。……お前はその子供の父親なのだろう？」
pointers.New Text:
There's directions to the
hospital over there. ...You're
that kid's father, right?
pointers.MT Text:
There's a way to get to the hospital
written over there... Are you this
kid's dad?

pointers.Original Text: 「ああ！　母親の姿が見えなければ、子供は父親を求めるだろう。今ここに父親がいないのであれば……」
pointers.New Text:
Ah! No mom? Kids seek dad. None
here...
pointers.MT Text:
Ah! No mom? Kids seek dad. None
here...

pointers.Original Text: 「俺が代理とはいえ父としてこの子を守る義務がある！」
pointers.New Text:
I have the duty to protect her
as her father, even if I'm just
standing in!
pointers.MT Text:
I have the duty to protect her
as her father, even if I'm just
standing in!

pointers.Original Text: 「ふーん、真剣に父親役になろうとしてるのね、あんた」
pointers.New Text:
Hmm, you're really trying to be
a serious father, aren't you?
pointers.MT Text:
Hmm, you're really trying to be a
serious dad, huh?

pointers.Original Text: 女の子の手が、環先輩の服の裾を掴む。
pointers.New Text:
The girl's hand grabs Senpai's
shirt.
pointers.MT Text:
The girl's hand grabs Senpai's
shirt.

pointers.Original Text: 今にも零れ落ちそうな涙をそっと環先輩の手が拭う。
pointers.New Text:
Tamaki-senpai gently wipes away
my tears that are about to fall.
pointers.MT Text:
Senpai's hand gently wipes away the
tears that seem about to fall.

pointers.Original Text: 「だいじょうぶ。これからお母さんに会いに行こう。俺も、みんなも……一緒だ」
pointers.New Text:
I'm fine. Let's go see Mom
together. I'll be with you and
everyone...
pointers.MT Text:
I'm fine. Let's go see Mom
together. I'll be with you and
everyone...

pointers.Original Text: 「だいじょうぶだろうか、だいじょうぶだろうか～」
pointers.New Text: Are you okay? Are you okay?
pointers.MT Text:
Are you gonna be okay, are you gonna
be okay~?

pointers.Original Text: 「殿が心配したってしょうがないじゃん」
pointers.New Text: It's no use worrying about you.
pointers.MT Text:
It's not like worrying about you is
gonna help.

pointers.Original Text: 「いやいや、今まさに新たな生命が芽吹こうとしているのだぞ！」
pointers.New Text:
No, no, new life is about to
sprout right now!
pointers.MT Text:
Nah, nah, a new life is just about
to sprout!

pointers.Original Text: 「でも殿の子供じゃないじゃん」
pointers.New Text: But you're not my lord's child.
pointers.MT Text: But they're not your kid, are they?

pointers.Original Text: 「代理でも立派にお父さんだ！　お父さんはお母さんを心配するものなんだ！　なあ、お母さん？」
pointers.New Text:
I'm still a great dad even as a
stand-in! Dads worry about their
moms, right? Mom?
pointers.MT Text:
Even as a stand-in, you're still a
great dad! Dads worry about their
moms! Right, mom?

pointers.Original Text: 「……俺は母親ではないと何度言ったらわかるんだ、お前は」
pointers.New Text:
I told you already, I'm not your
mother!
pointers.MT Text:
...How many times do I have to tell
you that I'm not your damn mother?

pointers.Original Text: 「無事出産しました！　丈夫な男の子です！」
pointers.New Text:
We had a safe delivery! It's a
healthy boy!
pointers.MT Text:
I had a safe delivery! It's a
healthy boy!

pointers.Original Text: 女の子が手を広げてこちらに駆け寄ってくる。
pointers.New Text:
A girl runs over with her arms
outstretched.
pointers.MT Text:
The girl runs over to me with her
arms outstretched.

pointers.Original Text: それを受け止めようと環先輩も手を広げて……。
pointers.New Text:
Takashi also tried to catch it
by spreading his arms...
pointers.MT Text:
Rinko-senpai also tried to catch it
by spreading her arms wide...

pointers.Original Text: 「ごめんな、お前を１人にしてごめんな」
「ううん、いいの。お母さん、男の子を産んだんだよ？　私、お姉ちゃんになるの」
pointers.New Text:
Nope, it's fine. Mom gave birth
to a boy? I'll be the big
sister.
pointers.MT Text:
No, it's fine. Mom had a boy,
right? So I'm gonna be an older
sister now.

pointers.Original Text: 「先輩、いつまでそうしているつもりですか？」
pointers.New Text:
Senpai, how long do you plan on
doing that?
pointers.MT Text:
Senpai, how long do you plan on
doing that?

pointers.Original Text: 「……う、うむ。だが……良かったな。うん、良かった」
pointers.New Text:
...Y-yes. But... it's good.
Yeah, it's good.
pointers.MT Text:
......y-yeah. But... that's good.
Yeah, that's great.

pointers.Original Text: この人って本当に涙もろいよね。
pointers.New Text:
This guy really is sensitive to
tears.
pointers.MT Text:
This guy really is a softie, isn't
he?

pointers.Original Text: 「ぐすひっく……ありがと、ハルヒ」
「それで鼻はかまないでくださいよ」
pointers.MT Text: Then don't pick your nose, okay?

pointers.Original Text: 「……ほんとあんたって馬鹿よね、馬鹿」
pointers.New Text:
You really are an idiot, you
know.
pointers.MT Text:
...You really are an idiot, you know
that?

pointers.Original Text: 「ま、憎めない馬鹿っていうのもいいんじゃないの、あんたの場合はさ」
pointers.New Text:
Well, maybe it's not so bad to
be an endearing fool in your
case.
pointers.MT Text:
Well, maybe it's not so bad to be a
lovable idiot, in your case.

pointers.Original Text: 「でもあんたは敵よ！　敵だから懐いたら承知しないんだからねー」
pointers.New Text:
But you're my enemy! I won't
forgive you if you get too
friendly!
pointers.MT Text:
But you're my enemy! I won't forgive
you if you try to get close to me!

pointers.Original Text: ……お父さん、素直じゃないなあ。環先輩のこと嫌いじゃないのに。
pointers.New Text:
...Dad, you're not being honest.
You don't hate Tama-chan, do
you?
pointers.MT Text:
...Dad, you're not being honest.
You don't hate Tama-chan, do
you?

pointers.Original Text: 「まだまだワタシはハルヒを手放す気はないんだからねー！」
pointers.New Text:
I'm not letting go of you yet,
Haruhi!
pointers.MT Text:
I'm not letting go of Haruhi just
yet!
